value.value: Original SAED panels 1E and 2C and lattice-resolved Figures 1A/3 are available. EDAX is named without a displayed composition result; no XRD, Raman or photoluminescence data for the current assemblies are presented.

value.value: Prior PbSe dots show small Stokes shifts, sub-microsecond interband lifetimes and fast 1S–1P / 1P–1D intraband relaxation; earlier thermoelectric work reports a Seebeck increase. These cited claims are not new lifetime, quantum-yield or thermoelectric measurements for this paper’s assemblies.
